text_block_list.text:
King Halo steps up to face the "Satsuki 
Sho," the long-awaited first leg of the 
Classic Triple Crown.

Appearing in the paddock, King Halo 
exchanges words with Seiun Sky, who is 
also running in this race.

Despite her elusive demeanor, Seiun Sky 
was in peak condition. King Halo 
understood that full well.

On top of that, acknowledging that she 
needed undeniable results, her relentless 
obsession with victory began to bleed 
through.
